_about: Story steps per location, in play order. Written from the game's script order in pret/pokeemerald; Draft until checked in play.
littleroot-town: You arrive in the moving truck. Set the clock in your room upstairs, then visit the house next door to meet your rival's mom.
Head north to Route 101 and save Professor Birch from a wild Zigzagoon.
Back at the lab Birch gives you the starter you used, then asks you to meet your rival on Route 103.
After Route 103 you get the Pokédex, and your mom gives you the Running Shoes on your way out.
After the Hall of Fame: once you've caught every Hoenn Pokédex entry (Jirachi and Deoxys aren't needed), Birch offers a Johto starter.
route-101: Birch is being chased by a Zigzagoon. Open his bag and pick Treecko, Torchic or Mudkip.
Once you have Poké Balls, catch Wurmple, Poochyena and Zigzagoon here.
oldale-town: A Poké Mart clerk walks you to the mart and gives you a free Potion.
The path west to Route 102 is blocked by a man sketching footprints until you've been to Route 103.
route-103: Your rival (May or Brendan) is at the north end. Battle them; their starter is the one weak to yours.
Go back to Birch's lab for the Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls from your rival.
The east side is reached from Route 110 (or by Surf later): come back then for the trainers and items there.
route-102: Head west from Oldale. Four trainers, and Ralts appears here (rarely, 4%). Seedot is here too.
Pick the berries from the trees here.
petalburg-city: Visit the Gym: your dad Norman is the leader, but he won't battle you yet.
Wally comes in and you go with him to Route 102 to help him catch a Ralts. Then head west to Route 104.
Come back after four badges (after Lavaridge) to challenge Norman.
route-104: South part: the beach and Mr. Briney's cottage. Go north into Petalburg Woods.
North part (after the woods): the Pretty Petal Flower Shop gives a Wailmer Pail. More trainers wait near the bridge.
Later, Mr. Briney sails you from his cottage to Dewford Town once you have the letter from Devon.
petalburg-woods: Help the Devon researcher: a Team Aqua grunt tries to steal his papers. Beat the grunt and he gives you a Great Ball.
Shroomish and Slakoth appear here, and Silcoon or Cascoon depending on Wurmple's evolution.
rustboro-city: Beat Roxanne at the Rustboro Gym (Rock type). Grass or Water moves make it easy; Torchic should learn Double Kick at 16 as Combusken.
Reward: Stone Badge and TM39 Rock Tomb.
A Team Aqua grunt steals the Devon Goods: chase him east to Route 116 and Rusturf Tunnel.
Return the goods to Mr. Stone at Devon Corporation. He gives you the PokéNav and a letter for Steven in Dewford, and asks you to deliver Devon Goods to Slateport.
Your rival battles you just outside the Devon building after you leave. The Cutter's House gives HM01 Cut.
route-116: Go east to chase the grunt. Several trainers, and Whismur, Nincada, Abra and Skitty live here.
Return later with Rock Smash: Rusturf Tunnel then connects to Verdanturf Town.
rusturf-tunnel: Beat the Team Aqua grunt to get the Devon Goods back and Peeko the Wingull returns to Mr. Briney.
With Rock Smash (after Mauville) clear the rocks to join Verdanturf Town; the tunnel couple reunite and give you HM04 Strength.
dewford-town: Mr. Briney's boat brings you here. The fisherman next to the Gym gives you the Old Rod.
Beat Brawly (Fighting). Flying or Psychic moves help; Machop and Makuhita hit hard.
Reward: Knuckle Badge and TM08 Bulk Up. Deliver the letter to Steven in Granite Cave first if you like; order is free.
granite-cave: Get the HM05 Flash from the Hiker at the entrance.
Find Steven at the back of the cave and give him the letter. He gives TM47 Steel Wing.
Abra, Makuhita, Zubat, Geodude and Sableye (deeper floors) live here. Aron is common on B1F/B2F.
route-109: Mr. Briney sails you north to Slateport after Dewford. The beach has trainers and the Seashore House (beat the trainers inside for six Sodas).
The Super Rod and Surf areas come later.
slateport-city: Deliver the Devon Goods to Captain Stern at the Oceanic Museum. Team Aqua grunts block the second floor: beat them.
Visit the Pokémon Fan Club and the Market; the shipyard is where the Submarine is built.
After the Hall of Fame your dad gives you the S.S. Ticket: the S.S. Tidal then sails from here to Lilycove and the Battle Frontier.
route-110: Your rival battles you here (north of Slateport, after the Trick House).
Seaside Cycling Road runs above the route; you need a bike from Mauville. Electrike, Gulpin, Minun and Plusle live here.
The Trick House challenges continue as you earn more HMs.
mauville-city: Wally's uncle asks you to battle Wally outside the Gym. Beat him and he heads home.
Get a free bike (Mach or Acro, you can swap) from Rydel's Cycles.
Beat Wattson (Electric). Ground types like Geodude or Marshtomp win easily.
Reward: Dynamo Badge and TM34 Shock Wave. Get HM06 Rock Smash from the house near the Pokémon Center.
Once you can Surf, Wattson asks you to shut down the generator in New Mauville.
route-117: West from Mauville. The Pokémon Day Care is here: leave two Pokémon to breed.
Illumise and Volbeat appear, plus Marill, Oddish and Roselia.
verdanturf-town: Wally's family lives here. Rock Smash through Rusturf Tunnel to reunite the couple and get HM04 Strength.
The Contest Hall here is the easiest first contest.
route-111: North of Mauville. The sand storm blocks the desert until you have Go-Goggles (Lavaridge).
A family of four trainers in the house near the north end battle you one after another.
route-112: Team Magma blocks the cable car. Go around through Fiery Path to Route 113.
fiery-path: A short volcanic cave: Numel, Koffing, Grimer, Slugma, Torkoal and Machop. Strength opens the TM06 Toxic spot.
route-113: Ash falls here. Get the Soot Sack from the glass maker's house and walk in the ash to collect it.
Trade ash for flutes and decorations later.
fallarbor-town: Visit Professor Cozmo's house and learn that Team Magma took a meteorite to Meteor Falls.
The Move Relearner lives here: one Heart Scale per move.
route-114: Head west. Lotad, Seviper and Swablu live here. Lanette, who runs the PC storage system, lives here.
Meteor Falls is at the north end.
meteor-falls: Team Magma steals the meteorite and Team Aqua chases them. Leave and go back south.
With Surf and Waterfall, the inner rooms hold Bagon. Steven's cave (after the Hall of Fame) is in the back.
route-115: North of Rustboro, reached from Meteor Falls. The beach needs Surf for most of it.
mt-chimney: Take the cable car up from Route 112. Beat Team Magma's Tabitha and then Maxie to stop them using the meteorite on the volcano.
Archie leaves after the battle. Take the meteorite. Then head down Jagged Pass.
jagged-pass: Downhill path to Lavaridge. The Magma Hideout entrance is here: open it later with the Magma Emblem (from Mt. Pyre).
lavaridge-town: The old lady by the hot springs gives a Wynaut egg. The herb shop sells cheap healing.
Beat Flannery (Fire). Water and Ground moves win; her Torkoal knows Overheat.
Reward: Heat Badge and TM50 Overheat. Your rival gives you the Go-Goggles when you leave.
Now go home to Petalburg to battle your dad.
mirage-tower: Found in the Route 111 desert (with Go-Goggles). Climb with the Mach Bike over cracked floors and use Rock Smash.
At the top pick the Root Fossil (Lileep) or the Claw Fossil (Anorith). Taking one sinks the tower. Revive it at Devon in Rustboro.
route-105: Surf south of Petalburg towards Dewford. Many Swimmers and the Island Cave (Regice, post-game).
route-106: The beach west of Dewford with the Granite Cave entrance. Fishermen and swimmers.
route-107: Open sea between Dewford and Route 108. Swimmers and Tentacool.
route-108: The Abandoned Ship sits here. Trainers on the open water.
abandoned-ship: Look around the wreck for items. The Scanner and the TM18 Rain Dance are behind locked rooms: find keys with Dive (after Mossdeep).
Give the Scanner to Captain Stern in Slateport for a Deep Sea Tooth or Deep Sea Scale.
new-mauville: Wattson gives you the Basement Key. Surf on Route 110 to the entrance, turn off the generator, and Wattson gives you TM24 Thunderbolt.
Voltorb, Electrode and Magnemite live here, and some items on the floor are Voltorb in disguise.
route-118: East of Mauville. Surf across, and the fisherman by the water gives you the Good Rod.
route-119: Long route through tall grass and rain. Kecleon hides in the path: Steven gives you the Devon Scope after Fortree to reveal them.
Team Aqua takes over the Weather Institute: beat Shelly and the researchers give you a Castform. Your rival battles you just before Fortree and then gives you HM02 Fly.
Feebas lives in six random tiles of the river: fish around until you find one.
fortree-city: A Kecleon blocks the Gym: wait until Route 120 for the Devon Scope.
Beat Winona (Flying). Electric, Ice and Rock moves win; her Altaria knows Dragon Dance.
Reward: Feather Badge and TM40 Aerial Ace.
route-120: Steven uses the Devon Scope on a Kecleon on the bridge and gives you the scope.
The Scorched Slab entrance needs Surf. Ancient Tomb (Registeel, post-game) is here too.
scorched-slab: A small cave reached by Surf. TM11 Sunny Day is at the back.
route-121: Team Aqua heads to Mt. Pyre. The Safari Zone is on the way to Lilycove.
safari-zone: 500 steps and 30 Safari Balls a visit. No battling. Pokéblock feeders help keep a Pokémon from running.
Some areas need the Mach or Acro Bike. The two extra areas open after the Hall of Fame.
lilycove-city: Your rival battles you outside the Department Store. Team Aqua's hideout is in the cove but blocked for now.
The Department Store has everything, including rooftop vending and TMs. The Move Deleter lives here.
The S.S. Tidal port is here (it sails after the Hall of Fame).
route-122: Surf south from Route 121 to Mt. Pyre.
mt-pyre: Climb the outside to the summit. Team Aqua takes the Red and Blue Orbs, and the old couple there give you the Magma Emblem.
route-123: One-way ledges back east to Route 118. The Berry Master's house gives free berries daily.
magma-hideout: Open it from Jagged Pass with the Magma Emblem. Beat Tabitha and then Maxie as he awakens Groudon, which leaves.
aqua-hideout: In Lilycove's cove. Beat Matt; Archie has already escaped with the stolen submarine.
The Master Ball is on B1F.
route-124: East of Lilycove. Dive spots and the Treasure Hunter's house (shards for stones).
mossdeep-city: Beat Tate and Liza (Psychic, double battle). Their Solrock and Lunatone are part Rock, so Water and Grass moves work, as do Dark and Ghost.
Reward: Mind Badge and TM04 Calm Mind. Team Magma then attacks the Space Center: beat Maxie and Tabitha with Steven as your partner.
Steven gives you HM08 Dive at his house. Dive on Route 128 to find the Seafloor Cavern.
route-125: The Shoal Cave is here. Shoal Salt and Shells at low tide make a Shell Bell.
shoal-cave: The tide changes every 6 hours, opening different rooms. Get the Focus Band and NeverMeltIce. Snorunt and Spheal live here.
route-128: Dive here to find the Seafloor Cavern entrance.
seafloor-cavern: Use Strength and Rock Smash to go through. Beat Archie; he wakes Kyogre and the weather goes wild.
route-126: Dive near Sootopolis to reach its underwater entrance.
sootopolis-city: Groudon and Kyogre clash. Steven takes you to Wallace, who sends you to the Sky Pillar.
After Rayquaza calms them, beat Juan (Water). Grass and Electric moves win, but his Kingdra is only weak to Dragon.
Reward: Rain Badge and HM07 Waterfall.
cave-of-origin: You visit with Wallace during the story. There is nothing to catch here in Emerald.
route-129: Open water south of Route 128. Wailmer and Wingull. Also on the way to Pacifidlog.
route-130: Mirage Island appears here on some days (Wynaut, Liechi Berry).
route-131: The Sky Pillar is here. Trainers on the open water.
pacifidlog-town: A village of logs. The man in one house gives TM27 Return or TM21 Frustration by your friendship.
sky-pillar: Climb with the Mach Bike to wake Rayquaza. It stops Groudon and Kyogre and flies off.
After the Hall of Fame Rayquaza waits at the top to be caught (Lv 70).
route-134: Currents into Slateport. The Sealed Chamber (Braille puzzles for the Regis) is here.
ever-grande-city: Waterfall up from Route 128. Heal and head into Victory Road.
victory-road: Long cave with Strength and Rock Smash puzzles. Wally battles you near the exit with his Gardevoir.
Strong trainers line the path; heal before the League.
pokemon-league: Beat Sidney (Dark), Phoebe (Ghost), Glacia (Ice) and Drake (Dragon) in a row, then Champion Wallace (Water).
Fighting and Bug moves for Sidney, Dark and Ghost for Phoebe, Fire, Fighting or Rock for Glacia, Ice or Dragon for Drake, Electric and Grass for Wallace.
After the Hall of Fame: the Battle Frontier opens, the Safari Zone extensions open, and the S.S. Tidal sails further.
roaming: After the Hall of Fame your mom asks about the TV. Pick red for Latias or blue for Latios. It then roams Hoenn's routes.
ss-tidal: Ferry between Slateport, Lilycove and the Battle Frontier, once your dad gives you the S.S. Ticket after the Hall of Fame. Event tickets take it to the special islands.
battle-frontier: Seven facilities. Beat the Frontier Brains for symbols. Move tutors here use Battle Points.
artisan-cave: Behind the Battle Frontier. Smeargle lives here.
desert-underpass: West of Route 114 after the Hall of Fame. The fossil you didn't take at Mirage Tower is here.
altering-cave: Route 103. Zubat only in the default game.
sealed-chamber: Dive on Route 134. Solve the Braille with Wailord and Relicanth in your party to open the three Regi caves.
desert-ruins: Route 111 desert. Rock Smash for Regirock (Lv 40).
island-cave: Route 105. Wait two minutes for Regice (Lv 40).
ancient-tomb: Route 120. Use Flash in the middle for Registeel (Lv 40).
marine-cave: After the Hall of Fame, the Weather Institute reports odd weather. Marine Cave then appears on Route 105, 125, 127 or 129. Kyogre is inside (Lv 70).
terra-cave: After the Hall of Fame, Terra Cave appears on Route 114, 115, 116 or 118 when the Weather Institute reports a drought. Groudon is inside (Lv 70).
southern-island: Needs the Eon Ticket event item.
faraway-island: Needs the Old Sea Map event item. Mew.
birth-island: Needs the AuroraTicket event item. Deoxys.
navel-rock: Needs the MysticTicket event item. Ho-Oh and Lugia.
